title: 嘉文四世·纸王冠
description: 金蓝甲胄嘉文坐在桌前折纸王冠，长矛旗帜安稳陈列，表情认真又可爱。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Jarvan IV is an adult Demacian prince with dark swept hair, a gold crown-like headpiece, strong eyebrows, and ornate gold armor with deep blue cloth. Keep his dragon-inspired shoulder shapes, fully armored torso, covered legs, and boots recognizable. His long lance and folded blue banner rest together in a secure weighted display stand, never raised for a charge.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small table and folds a modest paper crown, using both large gauntlets to crease its soft rounded points. A finished tiny crown waits beside a plain cup. One arched window and a blue curtain echo his clothing, while the ceremonial lance remains still behind the chair in a quiet craft moment.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, pale gold, paper cream, cool gray
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
